PRACTICE AREASAudit & AssuranceDirect & Indirect TaxationCorporate Advisory & StartupsAccounting & Virtual CFOContact our team

Support for business formation, corporate compliance, financing and transactions, shaped around the needs of established businesses and new ventures.

Building and sustaining a competitive enterprise demands sound structural design, disciplined capital management, and adherence to company law. We advise entrepreneurs and established corporate entities on vehicle selection (Private Limited, LLP, Section 8), secretarial compliance under the Companies Act, project financing, and transaction diligence. From preparing bankable project reports to performing business valuations and Ind AS convergence, we provide commercial and financial clarity at every strategic stage.

How is the scope of an engagement determined?

Services are agreed based on your requirements, applicable professional standards and the circumstances of the matter. Contact the firm to discuss the relevant scope and documentation.

Can related practice areas be combined?

Yes. Depending on the engagement, our partners can coordinate accounting, tax, assurance and advisory expertise, subject to applicable independence and professional requirements.

Common questions.

Does PSB Associates help with company formation and business setup?

P S B & Associates LLP supports company formation, business setup, corporate compliance and financial advisory for startups and established businesses.

Can PSB advise on LLP and partnership structuring?

The firm provides LLP and partnership formation, conversion, agreement and deed support, capital and remuneration structuring, and continuing compliance advisory through its dedicated LLP and partnership practice.

What details are useful for a business setup enquiry?

Share the proposed business activity, intended ownership structure and location, and whether you are forming a new entity or changing an existing one. The team will discuss the structure and compliance requirements relevant to your circumstances.
